title: 第15章 登门师兄很暖心第16章 入峰仪式拜师尊
content_zh:
;;
李观棋有些莫名，不知道是谁家的小孩。
“不过…这小丫头气血倒是不弱，应该才五六岁吧。”
没有多想，李观棋推开院门走了进去。
刚一进门的少年就愣在了原地，因为这院子实在是太精致了。
跟他以前在福隆村住的房子比起来，以前的房子简直就是猪圈…
前院之中有天雷峰上引下来的泉水流过，小桥流水，怪石松柏。
走过去就是一个石桌，进入院子就是一个极大的正厅，纵横六丈有余。
房间中的所有家具都是崭新的红木所制，穿过正厅就是休息的房间了。
一共有三间，一主两次。
这种环境简直太好了，后院还有一片土地，就是一小片灵园了。
土壤泛黑，上面撒着一些青色的粉末，应该就是保持灵园土壤的肥料。
咚咚咚。
轻缓的敲门声响起，李观棋连忙出来开门，门外却响起一道温柔的声音。
“师弟慢点~不着急开门。”
李观棋微微一愣，听这言语…
“难道是天雷峰的弟子？”
“不是说明天才是入峰仪式么？”
吱嘎~
当李观棋打开院门的时候，发现外面竟然站着七八个人，年龄都要比他年长一些。

每个人的脸上都带着笑意，有的人手里抱着棉絮，有的人拿着木盆一类的用品。
当几人看到少年蒙着眼睛的布条时，眼底闪过一抹心疼之色。
几人都是身穿一袭白衣的宗门服饰，只不过左右肩膀有两条紫色的雷霆刺绣延伸而下。
胸口处的宗门旗帜上的图案有一个紫色的雷字。
为首的竟然是一名皮肤略黑的女子。
女子约莫十八九岁，梳着高马尾，鹅蛋脸。
五官精致却皮肤略黑，大大的眼睛明亮无比。
女子眼神威慑的看了一眼身旁人，随后指了指少年的双眼，示意众人不要乱说话。
随后声音温柔的说道：“师弟你好，我是天雷峰二长老门下弟子，顾冉。”
“你喊我师姐就行哈哈哈，这几位都是咱们天雷峰的弟子，都算是你的师兄。”
“今天过来找你，主要是怕你今天没有铺盖棉絮。”
李观棋连忙侧身让开，对着几人笑着抱拳道：“师弟李观棋，见过各位师姐师兄，别在门口站着了，里面坐。”
顾冉招呼着身后众人就进了院子，身后几个人高马大的师兄更是直奔主厢房，把拿来的被褥都给铺上了。
看着莫名忙碌的众人，少年心中最深处的柔软突然被触碰了一下。
少年的过往经历一直都是他心中隐藏最深的东西。
现在的性格也是因为和苏玄一起相处八年的时间里，一点一点改变的。
或者说他在有意的模仿爷爷那种洒脱的性格。
顾冉这个时候来到少年身旁，拉着他的手臂走得极慢。
“慢点走，先熟悉熟悉环境，这脚下有一个台阶，上来就是石桥，十步。”
“右手边是石桌，左边就是池水了，你回头得小心点。”

“弟子宗服我就先从内务那边帮你领过来了，一会试试合不合身，不合身我叫他们换一个。”
“以后就把天雷峰当做自己家，我们就是你的亲人。”
“有什么事儿，回天雷峰喊一声，师兄师姐绝对力挺你！”
“谁要是敢欺负你，跟我说，顾姐给你出头。”
说了这么多，二人都还没从桥上走下来，足以可见走的有多慢。

Li Guanqi was a little confused. He didn't know whose child it was.
"But...this little girl's energy and blood are not weak. She should be only five or six years old."
Without thinking much, Li Guanqi opened the courtyard door and walked in.
The young man was stunned as soon as he entered the door, because the courtyard was so exquisite.
Compared with the house he lived in Fulong Village before, the previous house was simply a pigsty...
In the front yard, there are springs drawn from Tianlei Peak flowing through, small bridges, and strange rocks, pines, and cypresses.
Walking past there is a stone table, and entering the courtyard is a huge main hall, more than six feet in length and width.
All the furniture in the room is made of brand new mahogany. Passing through the main hall is the resting room.
There are three rooms in total, one occupied twice.
This kind of environment is simply great. There is also a piece of land in the backyard, which is a small spiritual garden.
The soil is black with some green powder sprinkled on it, which should be the fertilizer used to maintain the soil in the cemetery.
Boom, boom, boom.
There was a gentle knock on the door, and Li Guanqi quickly came out to open the door, but a gentle voice sounded outside the door.
"Junior brother, slow down~ don't be in a hurry to open the door."
Li Guanqi was slightly startled, hearing these words...
"Could he be a disciple of Tianlei Peak?"
"Didn't it mean that genius is a peak entrance ceremony?"
Zhiqua~
When Li Guanqi opened the courtyard door, he found seven or eight people standing outside, all of whom were older than him.
Everyone had a smile on their face, some were holding cotton wool in their hands, and some were holding supplies such as wooden basins.
When several people saw the cloth covering the young man's eyes, a look of distress flashed in their eyes.
Several people were wearing white sect attire, but there were two purple thunder embroideries extending down the left and right shoulders.
The pattern on the sect flag on the chest has a purple thunder character.
The leader turned out to be a woman with slightly darker skin.
The woman is about eighteen or nineteen years old, with a high ponytail and an oval face.
He has delicate facial features but slightly dark skin, and his big eyes are extremely bright.
The woman glanced at the people around her with a threatening look, then pointed at the boy's eyes, signaling everyone to stop talking nonsense.
Then he said in a gentle voice: "Hello, junior brother, I am Gu Ran, a disciple of the second elder of Tianleifeng."
"Just call me senior sister, hahaha. These are all disciples of our Tianlei Peak, and they are all your senior brothers."
"I came to see you today mainly because I was afraid that you didn't have any cotton wool on your bed today."
Li Guanqi quickly stepped aside, smiled at several people and clasped his fists, saying: "Junior brother Li Guanqi, I have met all the senior sisters and brothers. Stop standing at the door and sit inside."
Gu Ran greeted everyone behind him and entered the courtyard. Several tall senior brothers behind him went straight to the main room and spread out all the beddings they had brought.
Looking at the inexplicably busy people, the deepest softness in the young man's heart was suddenly touched.
The boy's past experiences have always been the deepest hidden things in his heart.
His current personality has also changed little by little because of the eight years he spent with Su Xuan.
In other words, he was deliberately imitating his grandfather's free and easy character.
Gu Ran came to the young man's side at this time, took his arm and walked very slowly.
"Walk slowly, familiarize yourself with the environment first. There is a step at the foot, and there is a stone bridge up, ten steps away."
"On the right is the stone table, and on the left is the pool. You have to be careful when you look back."
"I'll get the disciple uniform for you from the housekeeping department first. I'll try it out later to see if it fits. If it doesn't, I'll ask them to change it."
"From now on, treat Tianlei Peak as your home, and we will be your relatives."
"If anything happens, just shout to Huitian Leifeng. Senior brothers and sisters will definitely support you!"
"If anyone dares to bully you, tell me and Sister Gu will stand up for you."
After saying so much, the two of them had not yet walked off the bridge, which was enough to show how slow they were walking.
